title: Ending a hint clarifies an answer’s basis

captions.physics: Leaving a familiar indirect remark behind
captions.emotions: Feeling steadiness in a clarified answer

meaning: You can end a familiar indirect remark and explore its ambiguous meaning, feeling supported by an actual answer instead of a guess.
text: On your Vishuddha, Death in the physical position appears in ending a familiar indirect remark. The Moon in energy supports a wish to understand ambiguous meaning and separate what is known from assumption. The Emperor in emotions brings steadiness through a clarified answer. You can leave a hint and discover which question was genuinely asked. Support comes from heard words you both can refer to rather than complete knowledge of intentions.

For example, you stop saying “Someone clearly has no time” instead of asking whether conversation is possible today. You name the request and clarify what is known about time now. **An understandable answer is more dependable than a familiar hint**. You hear a specific proposal and discuss it rather than present busyness as an established lack of interest. Certainty concerns the present opportunity to talk. It promises neither identical availability every day nor one meaning behind every earlier pause.

Immovability appears if the clarity found becomes a general explanation of every later reply. Ending a hint then merely replaces a convenient guess with a more detailed version. The constructive Moon helps preserve attention to what is unknown in a new situation. You can rely on actual agreement and clarify changes; steadiness requires no omniscience, and a direct question cannot guarantee complete advance knowledge of every future silence.
